title: That's why — it gets cold at night.
scene: 他多带一件衣服，解释考虑。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: That's why — it gets cold at night.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: So you don't have to come back for me.

variations: "extra sweater" 换 "extra water"；"cold at night" 换 "thirsty on the way"。
